item.title: Audio EXP Podcast #319: Lawsuits, Legends, and Limited Editions
item.description: Explore the latest tabletop news in Audio EXP #319. This week covers the Hasbro lawsuit over Magic: The Gathering card overprinting, the announcement of Numenera: The Amber Archive, the Elden Ring: Nightreign TTRPG, and Matthew Lillard’s Ghost Face Vodka.

item.title: Smell the apocalypse: Merchoid unveils Fallout Vault Dweller candle set
item.description: Merchoid launches the Fallout Vault Dweller’s Scented Candle Set featuring Nuka-Cola, Sugar Bombs, and Hot Apple Pie scents for tabletop fans.

item.title: Women in Games 2026 Manifesto demands strategic shift in industry fairness
item.description: Women in Games launches the 2026 Manifesto to tackle gender imbalance and promote fairness as a strategic necessity in the global games industry.

item.title: Sam Healey departs The Dice Tower following social media controversy
item.description: Sam Healey has resigned from The Dice Tower after controversial comments regarding victims Alex Pretti and Renee Good.

item.title: The Satoshi Nakamotos of Fiction: Ten Authors Who Do Not Exist
item.description: We investigate the biggest unsolved mysteries in geek culture. From The Wandering Inn to Jujutsu Kaisen, these ten authors built empires while remaining total ghosts.

item.title: Adopt a Shoggoth
item.description: Turn your toxic ex into a Lovecraftian horror this Valentine's Day. Generate a custom Shoggoth stat block featuring special attacks like Gaslighting and Future Faking.

item.title: Help independent news: Pick March’s RPG Publisher Spotlight
item.description: The longest ever January is behind us, and we're speeding into the chocolate season of Valentine's Day (an excuse to buy chocolate) and Easter (also chocolate). In this post, our Patrons get to vote for a publisher that the blog and podcast will promote.

item.title: Swedish indie RPG Oceania 2084 wins Game of the Year
item.description: Oceania 2084 wins Game of the Year and Best Setting at the 2025 No Dice Unrolled awards, cementing its status as a top dystopian RPG from Swedish designer Johan Eriksson.

item.title: Teeth and Treachery: Exploring the Hex-Based World of Misbehave
item.description: Discover the charmingly grubby world of Goblin, a solo TTRPG prototype by Wojciech Rosiński and Hexy Studio where players recover a shattered crown.

item.title: From Frieren to Dan Da Dan: Crunchyroll Store unveils romantic picks
item.description: Crunchyroll reveals its February highlights alongside the viral Adopt-a-Shoggoth campaign, perfect for both anime lovers and fans of cosmic horror.
